name: new_bank_v2_saved_prediction_family_screen_and_robustness_vector
baseline_family: F0v2; GRABMyo names the same RestNoiseDetailV2 implementation F0
ece: ten equal-width confidence bins [0,0.1),...,[0.9,1]; sum bin_fraction * absolute(mean_accuracy-minus-mean_confidence)

axis_evidence.force: LibEMG cross-user instructed intensity, confounded with held-out users
axis_evidence.wearing: LibEMG native electrode shift within users
axis_evidence.day: GRABMyo eight-channel day 1 train, day 2 validation, day 3 descriptive final
axis_evidence.user: N/A independent user axis; force also changes user and cannot isolate a separate user effect
axis_evidence.quality: N/A real matching new-v2 quality comparison

supplemental: Song S03/S04 is one 250 Hz user and one date; report separately, never as independent day or user axis
selection: summary only from saved held-out predictions; no retraining, model selection or pooling of incompatible class sets
boundary: different devices, class taxonomies, rates and task definitions; final subjects/days/sessions descriptive where previously inspected
